subject: general
question: A, K, G, D, H and Y are sitting in a straight row facing north. K is at one extreme end. Y is sitting third from the right of K and second to the left of A. D and H are immediate neighbours. G is sitting to the immediate left of A. D sits third to the left of G. Who is to the immediate right of K?
solution:
**Given:**

A, K, G, D, H, and Y are sitting in a straight row facing north.

Seating arrangement according to the given statements:

1. K is at one extreme end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8670c8d8eba7c1570cd1ceb508ed593b7ca444507617f02c74b4d832d6679c1.png] 

2. Y is sitting third from the right of K.

​In case 2 there is no space at right of K so case 2 will be eliminated here.

 ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71c4da3058152dd5837bf374a8f6ee3cae5f543f2513e01c322c470a868eb9c3.png] 

3. Y is sitting second to the left of A.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17a26615fd27351f45606f8116ed95acb760c21b07755cc0ce3d15575d1fc87.png] 

4. ​D and H are immediate neighbors.

​There two possibilities when D and H can be immediate neighbors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9206cb3b36d1a5211c2785c51d49b89ea3f6b5df56cc8b875e9ec2e95d8fdda.png] 

5. ​ G is sitting to the immediate left of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7378689ef86ebb6cff973d42e44dfbc48f54793bc1e312c438f67f675c85f299.png] 

6. ​ D sits third to the left of G.

Therefore, case 1b gets eliminated here and the final arrangement is:​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8e3e37aa60252837e8b9bf376cc08d43833439483d7fbe29161fad40888038.png] 

Thus, ​D is to the immediate right of K.

​Hence, the correct answer is** 'D'.**
